text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Incredible! What a fiercely fought battle!
In the end, it was truly these two who gave us a contest for the ages!
(Wooooaah--!)

text_block_list.name: Espo & Falco
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *gasp*...
—*wheeze*... *pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: (My body feels so hot... My legs and shoulders are heavy...)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: (Still...)

text_block_list.name: Espo & Falco
text_block_list.text:
...I'm so strong...! 
Falco really is the strongest...☆

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Haaah!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...I thought I could at least say that much today!
I worked hard enough to run completely out of energy, after all☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Because Falco and I
hogged all of everyone's attention for ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Waaahhh! Falcooo!"
"Thank you! Espoir City!!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Your colors and my colors blend together.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Right at the center of everyone's sparkling eyes...
...Standing right in the center, it's us!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: We're looking our absolute most charming right now, after all♪

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Talking so carefree after it's all said and done... The nerve.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: You're quite the big deal.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Then you're a big deal too!
You're Falco's teacher, aren't you, Espo-san?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So next time, let's go to Dubai☆
Dubai!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Over there, there's also a world-class stage!
A dream on the dirt that moves so many hearts!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"So let's captivate everyone waiting across the ocean, too!
Together, you and I can do it—!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: No way.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ehh?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Don't drag me down your path.
Going somewhere someone else is already trying to trample over is just boring as hell."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
There's no path for me to walk except my own.
I'm the one who decides what finish line is worthy of me.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Besides...
being at the top of the world ain't just about that, right?
There's gotta be a way to be number one that's true to me, too.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...! Does that mean...
you're entering a different race!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh!
The two leading the current dirt scene...!
Are setting their sights on racing abroad...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure it'll work. You can win!
Because—
choice_data_list: (If it's Espoir City, she can win)

text_block_list.text:
"Espoir City had become a strong enough horse girl
to make one truly believe that."
"Good enough to aim for the world now. Good enough to aim even higher."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer.
...What do we do next?
choice_data_list: Let's go seize the glory that rightfully belongs to you.
Let's go claim the crown you deserve

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ! Haha...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...What is that?
Looking at her sparkling eyes, I make a declaration. I want her to claim many victories. —I want her to hold all kinds of glory in her hands.

I want to keep achieving great feats with her
that will be remembered in racing history forever.
choice_data_list: First, let's defend our title at the Mile Championship Nambu Hai!
First, back-to-back victories at the Mile Championship Nambu Hai!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hah! ...Hahaha...!
Back-to-back victories... Now that's a fine title!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah, let's do this!
I'm gonna be the strongest Umamusume in the dirt division!
And then, morning came.

The Umamusume are running into the school building one after another.
The time is 8:30. Short homeroom is about to start.
"Conversely, I'll go ahead and call a taxi to leave the academy."

I'm scheduled to head to a university today.
A new paper regarding Umamusume has been making waves,
and I managed to secure an appointment with the author.

A taxi pulls up right in front of us.
The door opens, and after getting into the back seat—
—  It's pitch black.  W  h  y ...?

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Well then, that concludes homeroom.
Everyone—
(RATTLE-CLATTER!)

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Tazuna-san...?
Is something the—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*... *haa*... *gasp*,
Espoir City-san...!
Um... Um...!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: This way—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Your Trainer
is at the hospital right now...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
In an accident... rushed to emergency...
The hospital is...—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...The Trainer... did?
